implementationFacts: Array lvalue decay is decided from the canonical expression type across named objects, record members, array elements, string literals, and compound literals.
Sparse, range, positional, and nested designators infer an unbounded array from the maximum occupied index rather than initializer count alone.
Function pointers and void pointers share one compatibility rule across initialization, assignment, arguments, returns, casts, conditional operands, and void-pointer arithmetic results.

Library and ctype builtins use their frozen prototypes without requiring a visible declaration; a visible incompatible declaration is E2927, and calls retain ordinary external-function C-HIR rather than adding an EvoIR intrinsic.
The C-locale ctype behavior byte-matches the sealed p28 table for 0..255, -1, and 0x130.
VaArg retains its requested object type in C-HIR; invalid operands are rejected and both interpreter paths plus lowering fail closed with E3030 at the variable-argument execution boundary.
GNU inline/restrict aliases and attributes interspersed between declaration specifiers use the existing canonical declaration representation.
Static address constants compose through pointer-width integer casts and decay of static arrays, members, and nested array elements.
